elapsed.text: It was not long ago. The ground is still turned.
The grass has started to come back over it.
Long enough that you had stopped walking this way on purpose.
Long enough that you have to think about the face.
Long enough that you had stopped counting, which is its own kind of answer.

first_visit: You stand at it a while. Nobody says very much.
Someone starts a sentence about them and does not finish it.
It is a poor marker. It is the one they got.
You clear the growth off it. It will be back.
return_visit: You come back past. It is still here, which is the whole of the news.
Nothing has changed. You did not expect it to.
Somebody has left a stone on it. Not one of yours.
inheritance: They told you this once, and you had not thought about it since.
You remember them explaining it badly, and it lands anyway.
It was their book. Somebody may as well carry it.
reinforced: You talk about them for a while. Everything you were carrying sits a little firmer.
lonely: There is nobody left to say anything, so you say it yourself.
